en-US.description: AI agent workspace that works across your local files and workflows.
en-US.longDescription: AnyGen is an AI agent desktop application that can work across your local workspace: it accesses files, runs actions, and helps automate end-to-end workflows. It also provides AI slide and document generation together with file-conversion tools such as PDF to PPT.
en-US.name: AnyGen
